title: Doozy Vape Co Orange Chill E-Liquid 10ml
description: Doozy Vape Co’s Orange Chill delivers a super-refreshing wave of sunny, succulent orange flavour, finished with an ultra-refreshing dash of cool menthol for an invigorating, fruity vape. The 70% Vegetable Glycerine, 30% Propylene Glycol formula makes this eliquid ideal for sub-ohm vaping, producing mighty clouds on top of fantastic flavour and a smooth, comfortable, throat hit. Sub-ohm vaping generally requires the use of high-powered vape kits, including pod vape kits and pod mods with higher power outputs, some pen vape kits and advanced kits .
